subject: Demo synthesis: security redlines, acceptance criteria & procurement path
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Coleman <aisha.coleman@bluecresthealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bluecresthealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo synthesis: security redlines, acceptance criteria & procurement path

Thanks again for your time this morning — great discussion and helpful questions. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned as you move this through procurement/legal: 

Key decision criteria you called out
- Data residency & encryption at rest (must-have)
- SOC 2 + annual pen test evidence (must-have)
- SLA: <100ms 95th p50 for the demo workload (target)
- Contract terms: 12-month term with option to renew; responsibility split for data retention

Immediate asks from BlueCrest
1) Procurement wants a short evidence bundle (SOC 2 snapshot + encryption/blind key notes).
2) Legal will do redlines on the SOW and data processing addendum — likely 1–2 rounds.
3) Request that we include a named economic owner for pricing/approval and a single procurement contact.

What I attached
- Mutual Action Plan v1.xlsx (timeline + owners)
- SOC2-snapshot.pdf (latest snapshot, controls summary)

Proposed next steps (my suggestion)
- You: confirm procurement contact and desired review window (e.g., 10 business days).
- RedWood (me): provide brief security pack and a redlined SOW draft within 48 business hours.
- Schedule a short alignment call with procurement + legal next week to walk the MAP and acceptance criteria (30 min).

If that timeline works I can set the call and push the SOW to DocuSign for initial signature once redlines land.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: Mutual Action Plan v1.xlsx (34KB), SOC2-snapshot.pdf (120KB)

From: Aisha Coleman <aisha.coleman@bluecresthealth.com>

Subject: Re: Demo synthesis: security redlines, acceptance criteria & procurement path

Thanks, Priyom — helpful recap. 

Confirming the procurement lead is procurement@bluecresthealth.com (cc'd). Tom (EVP Operations) will act as the economic owner for final approval. Our timeline: procurement will aim to complete the initial review in 10 business days, then escalate any contractual items to legal.

Two quick asks for your side: 
- Can you provide the SOC 2 control mapping (which controls map to our PHI/PPI handling) and a short note on KMS/HSM integration options?
- Please produce a version of the SOW that separates pricing line-items by hosted vs private deployment (we may request private for subset of data).

We can do a 30-min alignment call next Thurs (Mar 8) at 10am PT if that works for Redwood.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Coleman
Chief Product Officer, BlueCrest Health
aisha.coleman@bluecresthealth.com
